creatures.name: Bobim
creatures.identity: Um rolo de cartaz vivo, rosto e corpo integrados, duas abas auriculares e pequenos pés; olhos azul-gelo.
creatures.story: Começa enrolado no próprio papel, aprendendo a abrir seu abrigo para observar o mundo.
creatures.tradeoff: Sem pernas desenvolvidas, desloca-se em pequenos tombos.
creatures.review: Corpo-rosto único, uma espiral lateral, duas abas-orelhas, dois pequenos pés e uma rabiola curta com um terminal. Leitura simples e infantil; não replica a couraça adulta.
creatures.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE BABY first-stage Soulmonster, provisional BOBIM, pre-evolution of the supplied approved adult Trancoura. Input role is family palette and living-paper identity only, NOT adult armor or proportions. Extremely simple memorable little living ROLLED POSTER, a squat softly curled cobalt-paper pod with a single loose cream poster edge over its head, raspberry and mint geometric block on the edge, no actual text. Face and body are one small form with two small ICY BLUE eyes with dark pupils and a shy tiny curved mouth, tiny pointed dark nose hints at armadillo ancestry. TWO narrow soft paper ear tabs rise from the top, one bent, not round hyena ears. Two tiny mulberry toe buds at base, no developed arms or legs, no claws, no hard armor. The body is slightly asymmetrical, like a roll that has just begun to unroll, ONE clear spiral visible on side, not lots of concentric layers or wrinkles. One very short mint kite cord rabiola connects to the back ending in ONE little cream/raspberry folded paper fan. Innocent curious personality, leaning forward slightly. Broad smooth paper shapes and one compressed fold give volume. 45% creature,45% living kite materials,10% clean manga selective stepped outline. Pale ICE BLUE EYES, never orange yellow or amber. White backdrop, entire tiny creature with generous margins, square illustration, no inset view, no words, no symbols or watermark. Clean charming 2D MANGA monster concept, dark confident contour, flat cobalt/cream/mulberry with mint and raspberry accents, only two hard cel-shadow tones, no painterly gradients, no plastic/metal gloss, no realistic fur, no 3D, no adult reduced in size. It must read as a soft living paper baby before armadillo anatomy develops, NOT a snail with an external shell.

creatures.name: Tatimbo
creatures.identity: Tatu pequeno de quatro patas sob uma cobertura flexível de cartaz; focinho afilado e uma orelha dobrada.
creatures.story: Abre o rolo num teto flexível e começa a explorar, farejando e cavando com as primeiras garras.
creatures.tradeoff: A cobertura flexível ainda não resiste a impactos fortes.
creatures.review: Quatro membros, uma pata dianteira levantada, garras pequenas e focinho jovem. Cobertura larga de poucas peças, sem couraça segmentada adulta ou grevas; olhos azul-gelo.
creatures.prompt:
Use case stylized-concept. ONE original CHILD-stage Soulmonster TATIMBO, pre-evolution in the supplied adult Trancoura armadillo family. Reference role: family palette and 2D manga material only, do NOT shrink the adult armor. A small curious ARMADILLO child with a long soft tapering snout, tiny mulberry nose, two long narrow paper ears one slightly bent, expressive icy LIGHT BLUE eyes with dark pupils, no amber/orange/yellow eyes, a small pleased closed mouth, NOT a rabbit or fox face. Body compact rounded with four short sturdy rooted legs, forefeet modest 3 cream digging claws each and smaller hindfeet, childish head proportion but actual little elongated muzzle. Walking and sniffing at ground, near forefoot slightly lifted, three planted supports, all four limbs identifiable.

Living kite-paper anatomy: dark mulberry underside and limbs, cobalt soft head and back, cream/raspberry/mint large graphic poster blocks. SINGLE wide curved blue laminated-poster CANOPY is growing from back and shoulders, with thick cream torn edge folded over neck like a short protective hood, one broad crease across its width, TWO small ivory bamboo tension ribs and one mint root knot each. NO adult multiple shutter armor bands, NO dorsal scroll, NO hard greaves, no weapon. One side of the supple canopy lifts just a little, like paper shelter in breeze; integrated with creature's body not a worn human cloak. One complete short segmented tail from rump narrows into mint cord with ONE tiny cream/raspberry fan-shaped rabiola tip. Subtle paper cheek fold, some compressed belly folds, simple fourfoot anatomy, no hundreds of triangles. Temperament inquisitive, little guardian practicing sheltering itself, no aggressive stare.

45% living creature45% kite construction10% selective dark stepped manga contour. Clean confident inked 2D manga creature concept, solid cobalt/cream/mulberry and restrained raspberry/mint, just two or three hard shadow tones, matte, clear broad shapes. Pure white LANDSCAPE background, fullbody and tail with generous margins, no text, no extra panels. No 3D render, no shiny metal, no painterly noise, no adult armor reduced in size, no big fire aura or trash props.

creatures.name: Trancasco
creatures.identity: Corpo esguio de pescoço e pernas mais longos, cobertura rasa em placas largas e proteção em um antebraço.
creatures.story: Aprende a deslizar as placas para cobrir um lado do corpo enquanto mantém mobilidade para interceptar.
creatures.tradeoff: A proteção parcial deixa flancos e patas mais expostos.
creatures.review: Quatro membros legíveis, cintura recolhida, pescoço exposto e cobertura rasa. Não tem o domo pesado ou o rolo dorsal adulto. Duas proteções no antebraço próximo; cauda segmentada completa; olhos azul-gelo.
creatures.prompt:
Use case stylized-concept. ONE original YOUNG / adolescent Soulmonster TRANCASCO, a distinct intermediate before the supplied approved Trancoura adult armadillo. Use input as family colors, face lineage and crisp manga style only, NOT body silhouette. The adult is huge low armored dome; this young must be a LEAN LONG MOBILE ARMADILLO with visible waist and longer legs, noticeably different architecture from both round child and tank adult.

Four rooted legs with readable shoulder elbows wrists hips hocks, front legs strong but not enormous, feet have three curved ivory claws; narrow ribcage and long tapered mulberry neck, lower flatter back, long tapered armadillo snout partly exposed, two narrow paper ears, small determined ICE BLUE eyes (no orange amber yellow), a serious alert expression not a baby smile. THREE LARGE broad curved overlapping cobalt-paper plates form a shallow flexible accordion along upper spine, each thick cream poster edge with raspberry/mint geometric bands, NOT lots of small shutter slats and NOT a hemispherical shell. The front plate curls downward to guard one side of neck, leaving neck and jaw visible. The rear plate lifts just slightly at rump to expose its cream underside: NO towering scroll, no adult dorsal structure. Two ivory bamboo supports interweave with mint tension cords along plate edges, exposed lean belly and sides separate the shell from four legs. This is living kite body construction, not metal or a real armadillo wearing a saddle. ONE forearm has two sliding folded protective bands, other forearm and both hindlegs mostly unarmored. Very few fine paper tufts at wrist/cheek only, no fur mane. One complete LONG low segmented armadillo tail from rump narrowing into a mint kite cord and single broad cream/raspberry fan terminal. Tail must be entirely inside frame.

Pose of agile guardian bracing sideways to block a path, head raised slightly turning toward viewer, near forepaw extended planted, other three legs well separated and supporting. Make neck, waist and leg length clearly visible; avoid foreshortened round dome posture. Power in tensioned bands and stretching body, not bulky adult tank. One small mint pressure arc at shoulder, no flames, no dense particle effects. 45% creature45% kite10% dark selective stepped outlines/2D manga. Cobalt/cream/mulberry/raspberry/mint family palette, sharply separated values. Clean confident dark ink, flat matte solid colors and 2-3 hard cel shadows, no 3D or glossy metal, no painterly gradients, no scaly noise, no armor over every region, no huge spikes, no weapons, no human anatomy, no text. White LANDSCAPE fullbody concept with generous blank margins, simple contact shadow.
